en.name: Toaster pastries
en.summary: A box of toaster pastries keeps 6–12 months from purchase while the foil sleeves are sealed, and 1–2 weeks once a sleeve is opened. The sealed sleeve is the whole preservation system; once it is open the pastry stales fast.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark, 6–12 months from purchase. Each pair of pastries is sealed in a foil or foil-laminate sleeve that keeps out air and moisture, and that is what makes the box shelf-stable: the pastry is dry-baked and the filling is a high-sugar jam, neither of which is hospitable to bacteria. Once a sleeve is torn open the clock changes to 1–2 weeks, and what you are fighting is staling rather than spoilage — the pastry goes soft and papery and the filling dries at the cut edge. Fold the sleeve over and clip it, or move the pastry to an airtight bag.
en.fridge: There is no need to refrigerate toaster pastries and the fridge makes them worse: it is humid, and a dry baked pastry in a damp environment goes limp and leathery rather than staying crisp. Keep the box in a dry cupboard instead. If the pastries have a cream-cheese or dairy-based filling rather than a sugar jam, follow the instructions on that particular box, which may call for refrigeration once opened.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for toaster pastries. Freezing sealed sleeves does no harm and is a reasonable way to hold a bulk buy, since the pastries go straight from the freezer into the toaster with no thawing needed. The one thing to avoid is opening a cold sleeve in a warm kitchen, because condensation will soften the pastry immediately. Let the sleeve reach room temperature first, or toast the pastry straight away.
en.thawing: There is no need to thaw: put a frozen pastry straight into the toaster, and give it a slightly longer setting than usual.
spoilage: Pastry gone soft, limp or leathery instead of dry and crisp.
A rancid or stale smell from the fat in the pastry.
Mould in the filling or at the edges, usually after the sleeve was left open.
A torn or inflated sleeve, or a sticky, weeping filling.
tips: Keep the pastries in their sleeves until you are going to eat them.
Clip or bag an opened sleeve; that is the only thing holding the freshness.
Store the box away from the kettle and the hob — steam and heat both age it.
Toast from frozen rather than thawing on the counter.

faq.q: How long do toaster pastries last?
faq.a: 6–12 months from purchase in sealed sleeves, and 1–2 weeks once a sleeve is opened.
No, and the fridge makes them limp. Keep them in a dry cupboard, unless the box says otherwise for a dairy-based filling.
No timeline is published, but freezing sealed sleeves works well and you can toast them straight from frozen.

zh.name: 烤吐司餡餅
zh.summary: 整盒烤吐司餡餅在鋁箔小包未拆的狀態下，自購買日起可放 6～12 個月；小包一拆就只剩 1～2 週。那層密封小包就是它全部的保存系統，一拆開，餅皮走味的速度非常快。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光，自購買日起 6～12 個月。每兩片餡餅密封在鋁箔（或鋁箔複合材）小包裡，隔絕空氣與水氣，這就是整盒能常溫存放的原因：餅皮是烤乾的，內餡是高糖果醬，兩者都不適合細菌生長。小包一撕開，時鐘就換成 1～2 週，而你要對抗的是「走味」而不是「腐敗」——餅皮變軟變得像紙，切口的內餡則會乾掉。請把小包摺起來夾好，或把餅移到密封袋裡。
zh.fridge: 烤吐司餡餅不需要冷藏，冰箱只會讓它更糟：那裡潮濕，而乾烤的餅皮在潮濕環境中會變軟變韌，不可能維持酥脆。請放乾燥的櫥櫃。如果買到的是奶油乳酪或乳製內餡的版本，請依那一盒自己的指示處理，那類產品開封後可能需要冷藏。
zh.freezer: 烤吐司餡餅沒有公布的冷凍期限。把未拆的小包冷凍不會有害，也是囤貨的合理做法，因為它可以從冷凍直接進烤麵包機、完全不必解凍。唯一要避免的是在溫暖的廚房裡拆開冰冷的小包，水氣馬上會讓餅皮軟掉。請先讓小包回到室溫，或者立刻烤。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍：冷凍的餡餅直接放進烤麵包機，時間比平常稍微拉長一點即可。
spoilage: 餅皮變軟、塌、韌，而不是乾爽酥脆。
餅皮裡的油脂發出油耗味或陳味。
內餡或邊緣長霉，通常發生在小包被放著沒封好之後。
小包破裂或鼓脹，或內餡黏膩滲出。
tips: 要吃才拆小包，不要提早打開。
拆開的小包夾好或裝進密封袋，新鮮度全靠它。
整盒遠離熱水壺與爐台，蒸氣和溫度都會催老它。
冷凍的直接烤，不要放室溫退冰。

faq.q: 烤吐司餡餅可以放多久？
faq.a: 小包未拆自購買日起 6～12 個月，拆開後 1～2 週。
不用，而且會變軟。請放乾燥櫥櫃；乳製內餡的版本請依包裝指示。
沒有公布的期限，但整包未拆冷凍效果不錯，而且可以從冷凍直接烤。
